name: Ranger 3
about: Ranger 3 (1962 ALP 1, NASA/JPL), launched 1962 Jan 26. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Luna, Earth. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; turned to start where it left Luna
